text:
incident-bot: SEV2 — embed-service 5xx spike in eu-west-1. Error rate ~18% over 5m, p95 latency +200ms. Paging @sre-oncall @maria.gomez @ryan.lee :rotating_light:

sre-oncall: grabbing context. I'll tail logs and check autoscaler. tagging for handoff if I need to escalate.

maria.gomez: saw this hit after a high qps burst from an internal eval job. kvcache miss rate jumped. Will try enabling local prefix cache on podset-3.

ryan.lee: I'll notify CS about possible customer impact. @jess can you pull the list of active requests and any error reports?

jess: pulling Support -> searches for eu-west embed failures. Two paid customers showing 5xx alerts (Acme & SmartFlow). Acme severity 2 chat with support.

sre-oncall: mitigation step 1: scale embed-pool-eu to +2 replicas and enable fallback model-route (lower-rep mem footprint). Doing scale now.

sre-oncall: //cmd
```
kubectl scale deployment/embed-pool-eu --replicas=12 -n prod
rbacctl set route embed -> embed-variant-v1-fallback
```

incident-bot: deploy-bot detected config change: route update by sre-oncall. Canary started on 10% traffic.

maria.gomez: toggled prefix-cache for podset-3. Observed immediate drop in 5xxs for that podset in the logs. Keeping enabled while we monitor.

nate: putting short-term note: assume cause is cache eviction + burst causing overload on quantized execution path. Need to validate later.

ryan.lee: CS notified customers, sent interim update: "We're investigating elevated error rates and routing to fallback models to reduce errors." They asked for ETA. Suggest we set 2h initial ETA for postmortem.

sre-oncall: can everyone confirm service metrics? 5xx now down to ~3% and p95 latency trending down. Continuing to watch for 20m.

jess: Acme responded: losses reduced but they still saw a few failures. They're okay with continued updates.

emily: thanks all, good work. Please capture actions so we can put into a follow-up postmortem and schedule a brown-bag shareout for lessons.

sre-oncall: marking incident as contained. Will create a postmortem doc and assign owners. Quick action items I'm creating now:
- [ ] Confirm root cause hypothesis (cache evictions + autoscaler latency) — owner: maria.gomez — due: 2026-03-25
- [ ] Verify fallback model correctness and perf regression — owner: nate — due: 2026-03-22
- [ ] Add early-warning alert for kvcache miss rate > 8% — owner: sre-oncall — due: 2026-03-20
- [ ] Add runbook step to toggle prefix-cache safely in eu clusters — owner: emily — due: 2026-03-28

maria.gomez: I'll attach relevant logs and a flame graph to the doc. Also want to add a small test harness to reproduce the eviction pattern.

nate: I'll run a perf sweep on new fallback route to make sure no perf regression for latency-sensitive customers.

ryan.lee: scheduling postmortem meeting. Suggested slot: 2026-03-26 10:00 UTC (30m). If that works, I'll create calendar and invite SRE, ML infra, Product, and CS.

emily: 10:00 UTC works for me. Can we make it a recorded brown-bag so org can attend asynchronously? Add to Learning -> Brown Bags.

sre-oncall: created postmortem stub: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/1765432100 (private). Added timeline and actions. Will update with RCA once owners confirm.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: fallback route at 10% -> 100% canary success. No failures reported during rollout.

maria.gomez: initial RCA notes: short-lived kvcache eviction cascade after a background batch job increased memory churn. Autoscaler responded but pods hit a quantized kernel path causing CPU stalls and connection resets. Need to tune eviction thresholds and add backpressure to batch jobs.

jess: CS asks for an incident summary to send to Acme and SmartFlow. Can we have a 1-paragraph summary and timeline by EOD?

nate: I'll draft the technical summary, maria can add the root cause blurb, ryan can reword for customers.

sre-oncall: updating action tracker with owners and linking to PRs. Also adding 'postmortem review checklist' tag so we can ensure follow-through.

emily: for the brown-bag, propose agenda: 1) timeline & mitigation 2) RCA deep-dive 3) prevention patterns (runbooks, alerts) 4) Q&A + action owners. Target date: 2026-04-02, 11:00 PST.

ryan.lee: confirming CS message will go out after we finalize 1-paragraph and after postmortem doc has initial RCA. ETA EOD for customer note.

maria.gomez: quick note — I found two failing unit tests in cache eviction sim that give false negatives on memory churn. I'll open PR with fix and add a small staged load test.

nate: filing a smaller follow-up: instrument quantized execution path with more metrics (latency breakdown by kernel) — PR linked in postmortem. Owner: nate.

sre-oncall: closing incident thread. Status: contained -> monitoring -> postmortem scheduled. Postmortem doc link above; action tracker below. Please update your items when done.

incident-bot: Incident closed by sre-oncall. Duration: 47m. Severity downgraded to SEV3 for follow-up work.

emily: thanks team. I'll create the brown-bag invite and the internal 'prevention patterns' doc. Please add any notes you want covered to the postmortem before Thursday so we can prepare slides. :thumbsup:
